answers.explanation: An autonomous system, identified by its ASN.
BGP is the one inter-domain protocol everyone speaks. The others run inside an AS.
They know their own domain. Anything outside is reached through the default route toward the border.
Inside an AS, performance rules. Between ASes, business relationships do.
Intra-domain routing is the AS's own business. Only BGP at the border has to stay compatible.
Interior gateway protocol. Inter-domain ones are exterior gateway protocols (EGPs).
Inside one AS, the operator controls every router. Across ASes, you're trusting strangers.
The opposite: the split exists because no router could hold a map of the whole Internet.
